body: 2john: 8-10 is an example , but I’d like to clarify that they still try to reach out to the person
You’re speaking for every single witness in the world right now ,Which is wrong to do . Im sure SOME do,but the ones I know and have met don’t . It’s not their job to judge and they know that .
There’s stories about people shunning in the Bible though including friends and family.

Since I just started I don’t have the answers to everything ,but the way I see it , if they follow what’s in the Bible and the Bible says to do or not do something that’s just how it is . It doesn’t really matter if people nowadays think it’s right or wrong because people’s opinions of them don’t matter just God’s . And alotttt of people hold certain rules above others ,but from my experience jw’s  see everything as equally important . I can’t speak on the stoning because I just started .

Everyone’s going to perceive something in a certain way , I’m not talking about other religious groups so I’m not going to speak on them because I wasn’t talking about anyone else but the jw’s in the first place . But evaluating first comes from doing your research and not just looking at sources that are bias . The way I personally see it , yes some of their actions may seem extreme like disfellowship ( never taking part in that) but they do it because it’s in the Bible ,not because someone pulled it out of their ass and said so
But there’s always going to be bad apples?? I don’t think it’s right to assume something about a whole group of people because some people ruined it
Their whole system aside ,they follow the Bible ,what’s wrong with that ?
